dataset: GST on hotel accommodation and restaurant service in India
note: General information, not tax advice. Confirm your own case with a chartered accountant.

accommodation.notification: Notification 15/2025-Central Tax (Rate), dated 17 Sep 2025 (56th GST Council meeting)
accommodation.unit_test: Value of supply of one unit of accommodation per night (the value actually charged, not the rack rate); each room and each night tested separately
accommodation.replaced: Until 21 Sep 2025, rooms up to ₹7,500 were taxed at the old 12% rate with ITC.
open_questions: Dorm beds: whether the bed or the whole dorm is the unit for the ₹7,500 test is not settled (state advance rulings differ). Ask your CA.
Breakfast included in the room rate is one composite supply taxed as accommodation; whether the ₹7,500 band is tested including breakfast: ask your CA.

sources.title: PIB: FAQs on the 56th GST Council decisions (Q6, Q7: 5% mandatory, no ITC)
GST Council: press release on the 56th meeting recommendations

restaurant.rule: 5% without ITC, except a restaurant in specified premises at 18% with ITC
restaurant.specified_premises_test: For a financial year: a premises that supplied any unit of accommodation above ₹7,500 per unit per day in the preceding financial year, or that the supplier declared (1 Jan to 31 Mar of the preceding year), or that a new registrant declares within 15 days of registration

sources.title: Notification 05/2025-Central Tax (Rate): definition of specified premises
